developerType.description: company (a company form in the name), business (support email on the developer's own domain) or individual (contacts not saved).

companyName.description: Legal name when Google shows it, else the developer name.

email.description: Public support email of the listing (businesses only).

legalName.description: Legal name from the trader details Google shows for developers selling in the EU.

legalEmail.description: Email from the trader details (companies only).

address.description: Business address from the trader details (companies only).

phone.description: Business phone from the trader details (companies only).

privacyPolicyUrl.description: Privacy policy link of the top app.

topAppId.description: Package name of the developer's most installed app found.

topAppUrl.description: Google Play link of that app.

topAppInstalls.description: Installs as Google Play shows them, for example 1,000,000+.

topAppMinInstalls.description: Installs as a number (the lower bound).

topAppFree.description: Whether the top app is free.

topAppContainsAds.description: Whether the top app shows ads.

topAppInAppPurchases.description: Whether the top app sells in-app purchases.

topAppUpdatedAt.description: When the top app was last updated.

appsFound.description: Apps of this developer found by the run.

apps.description: Up to 10 of those apps: ID, title, installs, rating, category.

foundBy.description: Keywords, charts or apps that found the developer.

countries.description: Google Play countries where the developer was found.
